key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:120E
name: store_argument_and_recurse
description: Saves its first argument into a slot of the base-register block, then calls a routine passing that routine's own address, the second argument and a stack position. After the call returns it writes a zero byte through the pointer held in that slot and returns the call's result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:123E
name: store_byte_and_advance_pointer
description: Writes its byte argument at the location held in a slot of the base-register block, then increments that stored pointer by one. It returns the byte unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:125E
name: write_signed_digits_into_buffer
description: Repeatedly divides a value by a helper-supplied divisor and writes each remainder as a character from a lookup table into a buffer, working backwards from the end. When the sign flag is set it writes a minus sign ahead of the digits and returns the new buffer position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:12E4
name: format_string_with_arguments
description: Copies literal characters of a format string to an output routine, and at each percent sign parses optional flags, width, precision and length modifiers. It then emits character, string, signed decimal, octal, unsigned or hexadecimal conversions, using helpers to convert numbers and pad output, and returns the count written or an error.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1644
name: perform_signed_division
description: Determines the sign of the result from the signs of its two register inputs, calls a helper to compute the unsigned magnitude, and negates that magnitude when the signs differ. It returns the result together with the second input as a 64-bit pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:166C
name: call_and_conditionally_negate_result
description: Calls a helper, then negates the value the helper leaves in the second data register when the first data register holds a negative number. It returns that value together with the original second register as a 64-bit result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1686
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls another routine, then returns a 64-bit value built from the original second data register and the value the call left in that register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1692
name: recurse_into_same_routine
description: Calls the same routine it belongs to and then returns, so it re-enters itself with no other operation. The code shows no other work, so it is a plain self-call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:169C
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor. When the divisor exceeds 16 bits it uses a bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop, otherwise it divides in two 16-bit steps, and it returns the quotient and remainder as a 64-bit pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:16EC
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string from its start address until it finds the terminator, then returns the number of bytes before it. It does not write to memory.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:16FE
name: call_optional_hook_then_forward
description: If a function pointer stored in the base-register block is set, it calls that pointer first, then passes its argument to a helper routine. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:171C
name: clean_up_allocated_blocks
description: Passes the address and size of each block in a counted table to a helper routine, then passes the other stored blocks in turn when they are non-null. It also calls a stored cleanup pointer if one is set, and when a global flag bit is set it calls a library function through a global library base.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1804
name: close_table_entry_handle
description: Looks up an entry in a table by index and returns an error status, after recording an error code, when the index is out of range or the entry is empty. Otherwise it closes the stored handle through the DOS close wrapper unless a flag bit marks it as not needing a close, then clears the entry and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:185A
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Computes the upper 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit inputs from their 16-bit halves, using cross partial products. It returns that upper value paired with the second input.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:187E
name: forward_to_dos_close
description: Jumps through a library base pointer stored in the base-register block to the DOS close function. It adds no logic of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:18C0
name: forward_to_dos_open
description: Jumps through a library base pointer stored in the base-register block to the DOS open function. It adds no logic of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1944
name: forward_to_library_entry_point
description: Jumps through a library base pointer stored in the base-register block to a library function at a fixed offset, passing the current register state through unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1954
name: allocate_signal_backed_record
description: Allocates a signal number, then a cleared memory block of the requested size, and frees the signal again if the block cannot be obtained. It fills the block with a fixed type code, the signal bit and a pointer argument, calls a helper with the block or its inner field, and returns the block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:19E0
name: release_signal_backed_record
description: If a stored pointer is set, it calls a helper on the record first. It then sets the record's flag byte to all ones and its 32-bit field to minus one, calls a helper with the stored signal byte, and calls a helper with the record and a fixed size.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1A3E
name: forward_to_alternate_library_entry
description: Jumps through the same library base pointer as its neighbours to a different library function at a fixed offset. It adds no logic of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1A42
name: jump_through_library_base_pointer
description: Jumps through a library base pointer stored in the base-register block to a library function at a fixed offset, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1A66
name: jump_to_library_entry_point
description: Jumps through the same kind of library base pointer to another library function at a fixed offset, adding no logic of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1A7E
name: jump_to_secondary_library_entry
description: Jumps through the library base pointer stored in the base-register block to a library function at a fixed offset, passing registers through unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1A82
name: jump_to_shared_library_entry
description: Jumps through the library base pointer stored in the base-register block to the same library function as its neighbouring stub, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1AAA
name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Stores the address of its argument into the location that argument points to, then adds four to that stored value. It clears the next word of the block and writes the original pointer into the word after that.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1AD2
name: jump_to_distinct_library_entry
description: Jumps through the library base pointer stored in the base-register block to a further library function at a fixed offset, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1B3E
name: jump_to_second_library_base
description: Jumps through a library base pointer held in a different slot of the base-register block to a library function at a fixed offset, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1B9A
name: jump_to_third_library_base
description: Jumps through another library base pointer held in the base-register block to a library function at a fixed offset, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0000
name: start_program_after_clearing_memory
description: Program entry point that zeroes a large block of the base-register area and records the stack pointer and a global pointer. It calls a library function through a global base, then calls a second library function if the result is zero, and otherwise calls another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0006
name: verify_memory_then_enter_loop
description: Initialises a state counter and several library resources, then compares a stored size against a threshold. When the size is too small it calls a routine with the address of the referenced text 'Not enough memory', then sets default fields and enters an endless loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:00DE
name: poll_input_and_update_board
description: Polls for pending input messages, stores their coordinate fields and branches on several message classes. It selects board squares for moves and calls a routine with the referenced text 'Boards are not synchronized' when the board state disagrees, then returns numeric status codes to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0684
name: run_counter_gated_calls
description: Calls a library function, then runs helper calls each gated by a small counter, passing two stored values to one of them. It calls a further helper when two stored state values equal two, and ends with another library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0686
name: run_counter_gated_calls_variant
description: Repeats the counter-gated sequence of library and helper calls used by its neighbour, with the same two state-value checks, and ends with a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:06F6
name: take_flag_and_return_block
description: If a flag byte in the base-register block is set, it calls a library function, clears the flag, calls a helper, and returns the address of a fixed block. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0716
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero immediately, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:071A
name: build_cell_attribute_table
description: Fills a 64-entry byte table by visiting each row and column pair in a fixed order. It reads a cell type from a lookup table and combines a computed code with flag bits from a neighbouring table, calling helpers before and after the loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0770
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_loop
description: Continues filling the 64-entry attribute table from register-held state, computing each entry from the previous cell type and a neighbouring flag. It calls one helper once all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0774
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_step
description: Fills the same 64-entry attribute table from register-held state, computing each entry from the cell type and a neighbouring flag. It calls one helper once all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:079A
name: fill_attribute_entries_from_mid
description: Enters the attribute-table fill loop at a different point, computing each remaining entry from register-held state. It calls one helper once the table is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:07A0
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_tail
description: Enters the attribute-table fill loop at a later point, computing the final entries from register-held state. It calls one helper once the table is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:07B4
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_alt
description: Continues filling the 64-entry attribute table from register-held state, starting from a fixed initial code. It calls one helper once all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:07BA
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_branch
description: Fills the 64-entry attribute table from register-held state, computing each entry from the previous cell type and a neighbouring flag. It calls one helper once all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:07CE
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_late
description: Fills the 64-entry attribute table from register-held state at a later entry point, computing each code from the cell type and a neighbouring flag. It calls one helper once all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:07E6
name: fill_cell_attribute_entries_flagged
description: Fills the 64-entry attribute table from register-held state, setting each entry's flag from a fixed value and computing its code from the cell type. It calls one helper at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0800
name: fill_cell_codes_into_table
description: Writes a code byte for each of the 64 entries of the attribute table in sequence, computed from the cell type and a neighbouring flag. It calls one helper when all entries are written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0820
name: build_row_occupancy_bitmasks
description: For each of eight rows, clears one byte of a bitmask block and sets one bit per column whose attribute entry has its low three bits non-zero and a flag matching the argument's truth value. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0898
name: reset_two_stored_fields
description: Sets a first stored field to all ones, calling helpers around that change when it was not already set. It then calls a helper with zero and sets a second stored field to all ones.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:08D6
name: initialise_state_then_loop
description: Initialises several state fields, copies a five-value record into a saved block, and calls helpers in a six-step loop. It copies a 480-byte block, sets eight stored bytes to all ones, then runs an event loop that dispatches on status codes returned by a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0AA8
name: copy_block_then_dispatch_events
description: Copies 480 bytes from a stored source pointer into an output buffer, then loops on status codes from a helper. It handles selection and move codes, clears the 64-entry table on one code and copies the 480-byte block on another.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0ADC
name: process_status_codes_in_loop
description: Applies a stored cell value to a field, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. A clear-table code empties the 64-entry table, a copy-block code copies 480 bytes, and a further code calls a library function and copies stored fields when it succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0BAA
name: initialise_cell_table_and_loop
description: Writes a fixed flag value and a stored value into each of the 64 table entries, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move, clear-table, copy-block and library-call codes, and returns when the library call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0BD8
name: apply_pending_cell_and_loop
description: Applies a pending cell value from the table to a stored field when one is set, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles clear, copy and library-call codes and returns when the library call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0C40
name: update_selection_and_dispatch_codes
description: Updates a stored selection field from a coordinate range, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move and clear codes, copies a 480-byte block on one code and calls a library function on another.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0CA0
name: check_range_and_dispatch_codes
description: Sets a stored field when a coordinate range fits, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move, clear, copy and library-call codes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0CD2
name: find_free_slot_or_fail
description: Searches a 32-entry table for an empty slot. When none is free it clears a stored field and calls a routine with the referenced text 'Too many pieces.', otherwise it records the slot and calls a helper. It then loops on status codes returned by a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0D00
name: store_index_then_dispatch_events
description: Stores an index into a slot field, calls a helper with that index and a stored value, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move, clear, copy and library-call codes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0D46
name: clear_table_then_dispatch_events
description: Clears the 64-entry table and its code bytes, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move codes and updates a stored selection, copies the 480-byte block on another code and calls a library function on a third.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0D84
name: copy_block_then_loop
description: Copies 480 bytes from a stored source pointer into the table, calls two helpers, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move and clear codes, updates a stored selection, and calls a library function on a further code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0D94
name: copy_incoming_block_then_loop
description: Copies 480 bytes from a source pointer into a destination, then loops on status codes returned by a helper. It handles move, clear and copy codes, and calls a library function on one of them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0DBA
name: loop_while_status_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and, while it returns a nonzero value, clears a stored field and forwards that value to another helper. Inside, it loops on status codes for move, clear and copy handling.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0DD2
name: reset_input_state_then_call
description: Points a state pointer at a stored block, clears two state fields and copies two words from its argument block into state fields. It calls two library functions through a global base, calls a helper, then calls a helper again when a state field is nonzero before clearing a flag byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1A
name: dispatch_status_codes_forever
description: Runs an endless loop on status codes returned by a helper, handling move, clear-table, copy-block and library-call codes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1C
name: handle_status_then_fetch_next
description: Handles one status code passed in a register: move codes update the cell and selection state, one code selects a square and a clear code empties the 64-entry table. A copy code copies 480 bytes and a library-call code calls a function and returns when it succeeds. It then fetches the next status from a helper and repeats.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0E5A
name: forward_argument_to_helper
description: Passes its single argument to a routine and returns with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0E76
name: call_stored_pointer_then_helper
description: Calls a function pointer held in the base-register block with its argument, then calls a helper with no arguments and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0E92
name: map_screen_point_to_cell
description: Converts a screen point given as two 16-bit coordinates into a cell index by scanning two boundary tables of nine entries each. Points outside the grid clear the stored selection and call a helper. Points inside either toggle a flag and call a helper when the cell is already selected, or clear the previous selection and highlight the new cell when its bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:0FC6
name: save_and_reset_selection_state
description: Passes two stored coordinate values to a helper, copies one saved byte and resets two coordinate fields to all ones. It clears a pending block by calling a helper when one is set, then copies two more state bytes and clears three state fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1032
name: restore_saved_selection_state
description: Restores two coordinate fields from saved bytes and calls a helper with the fixed argument 28. It then restores two more state fields from saved bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1070
name: read_line_of_text_input
description: Reads a line of typed characters into a buffer, showing an underscore as a cursor. It appends printable characters up to a maximum length, deletes the previous character on backspace and stops at the return key, then terminates the buffer and returns its length.

name: blit_record_with_fixed_masks
description: Computes the image size from a record's width and height, then writes blitter registers with fixed mask values and pointers derived from the record and a stored base. It enables DMA and calls a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:3DC8
name: store_sprite_record_in_table
description: Stores coordinates, sizes and a pointer into a table entry selected by an index argument, clears its flag byte, and computes right and bottom bounds from the record's width and height.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:3E82
name: draw_text_menu_panel
description: Measures the longest string in a list of entries to size a panel, then draws the frame with several helper calls. It writes rows of text for each item, fills a set of rectangle records for the entries and calls helpers to draw each label.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:4392
name: scroll_menu_rows_and_clear
description: Redraws menu rows repeatedly while the row offset is above a limit, moving the offset up by eight each step, then draws the closing rows. It clears two record tables, stores fixed pointers and sets a stored value to all ones.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:4560
name: build_menu_item_records
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of strings and draws a record for each entry through helper calls, using the string length to decide how many records each entry needs. It stores the count of entries when finished.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:46FA
name: return_selected_entry_value
description: Returns the value stored for the current selection when the selected index and a neighbouring index are valid and a flag byte is set, otherwise it returns zero. It clears the selection index and calls a helper with two fixed arguments.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:4782
name: draw_entry_with_highlight_state
description: Loads the string pointer for an entry from a table and calls a helper with a display code of 25 when the second argument is nonzero, and 0 otherwise. The width argument comes from a stored value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:47DC
name: update_menu_hover_selection
description: Checks a pointer position against the menu rows and the item list. When it lies over an entry it changes the highlighted index and calls helpers to draw the highlight, and when it leaves the menu it clears the highlight.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:4914
name: draw_padded_menu_label
description: Copies a menu entry's label into a local buffer, pads it with spaces to a width derived from the row count, and draws it with a helper using a style chosen by a flag byte in the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:49F8
name: toggle_blink_state_and_draw
description: When a selection is active it toggles a stored state between two entries, looks up a stored pointer for that state and calls helpers to draw it. It passes a value derived from one helper's result and a constant to another helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:4B1A
name: draw_cell_highlight_rectangles
description: For a cell index below 64 it computes the cell bounds from two boundary tables and clamps them to a fixed area. It draws outline rectangles around the cell through helper calls, with a second pass using a stored pointer when a flag is set, and draws inner marker lines when a matching cell is selected.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:50A4
name: fill_region_in_strips
description: Fills a rectangle by walking it in strips whose width is derived from the region's width, computing each strip's end with a division. It calls helpers for each strip until the area is covered.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5138
name: shuffle_table_and_mask_rows
description: Shuffles a sixteen-entry table by swapping each entry with a randomly chosen later entry. It then ANDs each row of a block with table entries offset by the row index, calling a helper per row, and restores a stored field at the end.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:51D2
name: mask_rows_with_shuffled_table
description: Continues the table-masking pass over a block of rows, ANDing each word with a table entry selected by a rotating index. It calls helpers at each row boundary and returns when all rows are processed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5250
name: stub_no_op_handler
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is referenced as a handler pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5258
name: wait_for_window_message_code
description: Repeatedly fetches messages from a port held in the base-register block and releases each one. It returns once a message with code 104 arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5262
name: poll_window_messages_until_flag
description: Repeatedly fetches messages from a window port and releases each one, setting a flag when a message with code 104 arrives. It returns once the flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:538A
name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries and stores each base in the base-register block. A failed open calls a routine with the matching referenced text, 'unable to open graphics library.' or 'unable to open intuition library.', and a failed intuition open closes the graphics library first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:543E
name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a screen and then a window, storing their handles in the base-register block. A failure calls a routine with the referenced text 'unable to open a screen.' or 'unable to open a window.', and a failed window open closes the screen first. It then sets pointers from fields of the window structure.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5538
name: transfer_32_bytes_via_handle
description: Calls a library function with a stored handle, the argument pointer and a fixed length of 32 bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5554
name: transfer_32_bytes_from_record
description: Calls the same library function with a stored handle, a pointer to a record field and a fixed length of 32 bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5570
name: close_window_then_screen
description: Calls two library functions with stored handles in turn, releasing the window and then the screen.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:558C
name: close_graphics_and_intuition_libraries
description: Closes the two library bases stored in the base-register block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:55A8
name: write_decimal_digits_to_buffer
description: Writes a number to a buffer as decimal digits: a zero argument writes the character zero, otherwise it calls a helper to write the leading part and then writes the final digit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:55BC
name: write_single_decimal_digit
description: Calls a helper with a stored value, then writes the resulting remainder as one decimal digit character into a stored buffer and advances that pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:55F6
name: index_occupied_cells
description: Scans 64 cells in order. For each marked cell it records its position in two index tables and calls a helper with an entry from a pointer array, moving to the next pointer every eight cells.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:569A
name: convert_point_to_cell_coordinates
description: Subtracts an origin from a two-component point, then divides each component by a cell size with rounding to the nearest cell. Negative components are rounded by subtracting half the cell size, and the two results are stored in the base-register block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5726
name: convert_offset_to_cell_coordinates
description: Computes two rounded coordinates from a stored origin, a stored step and a size, dividing by the size and storing the results in the base-register block. The second coordinate uses a separate sign test.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:577A
name: convert_y_coordinate_to_cell
description: Computes one rounded coordinate from a stored origin, a stored step and a size, and stores it in the base-register block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:57A8
name: append_event_record
description: Appends a six-byte event record to a linked list held in the base-register block, storing its type and parameters, and returns the new record index. When the record type is three and its two values differ, it calls helpers to process the change.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:57DE
name: append_event_record_from_registers
description: Appends an event record built from register values and the caller's record fields to a linked list, similar to its neighbouring routine. It calls helpers when a type-three record's two values differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:57F4
name: append_marker_event_record
description: Sets a cell flag when the record type is not eight, then appends an event record to the linked list. It calls helpers when a type-three record's two values differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5856
name: append_record_to_list_tail
description: Walks a linked list to its last entry and links a new six-byte record there, storing its type and parameters. It calls helpers for a type-three record whose two values differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5872
name: store_record_at_list_index
description: Stores a six-byte record at the next free index of a table and links it into a list. It calls helpers when a type-three record's two values differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:58DC
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls a helper routine and returns with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:58F2
name: enqueue_input_event_record
description: Stores a four-byte record in a ring buffer of 32 entries, then updates stored flags when its type is five or is not eight. It saves the buffer index in a stored byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:596A
name: read_cell_flag_into_field
description: Copies the low three bits of a table entry, selected by an index argument, into a stored field, then returns the buffer index byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:5980
name: mark_cell_flag_for_type
description: Sets a flag entry in a table to one, indexed by the low three bits of a table value, unless the type argument equals eight.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:59B6
name: create_typed_event_record
description: Builds a new event record for a table entry, choosing its fields by a type code from one to eight. Some types take a value from a helper and a table, others update a table cell or a stored counter, and each type calls helpers before the record is linked into a list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:611A
name: append_node_to_list
description: Walks a list to its tail, links the given node after it and clears the node's link. It returns the original head of the list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6134
name: link_node_after_chain
description: Walks from a stored node along its links to the last one, then attaches the second node there and clears that node's link.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6140
name: link_pointer_chain
description: Stores the second pointer at the link offset of the first, and clears the link of the second pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6150
name: unlink_node_from_list
description: Finds the link that points to the given node in a list held in the base-register block, replaces it with the node's own next link, and calls a helper with the node.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6186
name: process_event_list_by_type
description: Walks a list of event records and dispatches each one to a handler chosen by its type code from one to eight. For a record the handler accepts it clears a cell flag and calls helpers. It returns one when the list is empty and zero after walking it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6290
name: advance_record_step
description: Checks a record through a helper, then either loads a step sequence and counts its steps or advances the step index. It calls helpers with the current position and returns one once the sequence is finished.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:62B2
name: start_record_position_sequence
description: Starts a stored position sequence for a record by counting its entries, sets the record's step fields and calls a helper with the first position. It stores the advanced pointer back into the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:62E0
name: count_sequence_entries_and_start
description: Counts the entries of a stored position sequence, stores the count and first pointer in the record, and calls a helper with the first position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6306
name: start_position_sequence_at_first
description: Sets a record's count field to eight, loads the first position from a sequence and calls a helper with it. It then stores the advanced pointer back into the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6326
name: advance_position_pointer_once
description: Loads the next position from a stored sequence, advances the sequence pointer and calls a helper with the position. It clears a field and stores the pointer back into the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:638E
name: step_record_through_sequence
description: When the record's step index is below its count, it calls helpers with the current position, advances the step index and stores the pointer. Otherwise it copies the final position from a table into the record and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:63C8
name: step_record_position_once
description: Calls helpers to step a record's position, advances its step index and stores the updated sequence pointer back into the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:648E
name: mark_record_finished
description: Sets a record's completion field to one, stores the current sequence pointer back into the record and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6712
name: show_header_and_list_entries
description: Draws a screen with the referenced header 'Quartex 1988:', counts the entries of a text block and writes a formatted count prefix. It then fills a table of string pointers from the block and calls helpers for each line.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6A04
name: advance_text_sequence_record
description: Advances a record through a stored sequence of entries, loading the current entry's fields and calling helpers for each step. It returns one when the sequence is finished and zero while it continues.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6A34
name: step_sequence_record_pointer
description: Steps a record through its sequence of entries, loading the current entry, calling helpers for it and storing the advanced pointer. It returns true while steps remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6A68
name: step_sequence_record_once
description: Loads the current entry from a record's sequence, advances the step, calls helpers and stores the pointer back. It returns true while entries remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6A82
name: step_record_with_fixed_count
description: Stores a count derived from an argument, loads the current sequence entry, calls helpers and advances the step. It returns true while steps remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6B0A
name: step_record_and_mark_active
description: Loads a stored value into a record, calls helpers for the current sequence entry, marks the record active and advances its step. It returns true while steps remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6BA6
name: store_pointer_and_return_zero
description: Stores a value from the local frame into the location pointed to by its argument and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:6BB0
name: process_record_sequence_step
description: When a counter field in the record is zero, it resets the counter and processes the current sequence entry with helpers, otherwise it decrements the counter and returns zero. It advances the stored pointer and returns one when the sequence is finished.
